dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I received my order yesterday, but the color is wrong.
dialogue.translation: Agoo, mifa so m’atɔmwɔfi anɔpa, nanso n’atɛm anuonyam.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you send me a photo of the item you received?
dialogue.translation: Mepɛ me ka me kyerɛ wo nyansa. W’atɔ so mfa wo fa soɔ ne din?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll send it right away. Also, I need to return the item and get a refund.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. How long will I have to wait for the refund?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: Pa pa, mɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Mɛdɔ wo ase ma wo resɛse m’akɔnhyɛn no.

dialogue.text: I think plastic waste is a serious problem, but people still use too much of it.

dialogue.text: Not fully, although I knew the salary was higher in the second job.
dialogue.translation: Ɛmmɔ, sɛdeɛ mɛhu adwuma a ɛdi kan no no adwene yɛ ɛho hɔ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what did you finally decide?
dialogue.translation: Enti, deɛ wade a wade no?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I chose the first job, rather than the second, due to the shorter commute and better work-life balance.
dialogue.translation: Mɛkyɛɛ adwuma a ɛdi kan no, maa yɛ mɛkɔ no ho a ɛyɛ den ne adwuma-adwene a ɛyɛ den pɛ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've changed my mind about the trip to the beach this weekend.
dialogue.translation: Mesɛe me adwene wɔ me ntwɛm a mepɛ sɛ meyi mu nsie a ɛbɛkyɛkɔ akyiri no ho.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? Why? You seemed so excited about it before.
dialogue.translation: Nokware? Dɛn nti? Ɛsɛ sɛ wopɛ yie wɔ hɔ a ɛfiri.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I realized that the weather forecast is bad, and actually, I have a lot of work to do.
dialogue.translation: Yiw, m’anye hu sɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔde ahyɛse wɔ ɔdɔman no mu no mmɔɔ, na yiye, mawɔ nnyinasoɔ pii.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But you had a plan to relax and enjoy the sun!
dialogue.translation: Nanso wɔba n’adwene sɛ wobɛtwa mu na wobɛhwɛ anɔpa!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but I realized that it's not possible to finish my project if I go. Since the deadline is Monday, I need to stay home.
dialogue.translation: Yiw, nanso m’anye hu sɛ ɛmpɛ sɛ mebɛkɔ so m’agyapade no ase sɛ meyi mu. Sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, ɛno ara na ɛyɛ adapa a, ɛsɛ sɛ mebɛka mu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a fact. But you could work in the morning and go later, instead of canceling everything.
dialogue.translation: Ɛyɛ nokware. Nanso ɛbɛyɛ a, ɛno ara na ɛyɛ adapa a, ɛsɛ sɛ mebɛka mu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, though I need to see if my friend can support me with the ride. Thanks for the advice!
dialogue.translation: Ɛyɛ adwene paa, nanso ɛsɛ sɛ mebɛhu sɛ me nua bɛkɔkɔ me wɔ me ntwɛm no mu. Meda ase wɔ wo kyerɛsɛm no ho!

scenario: Talking about cultural differences
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Wɔka ho ase wɔ nnwim, adwuma ne nneyɛe a wɔwɔ ha wɔ akomam abusua biara so.
Nnwim bi a wɔwɔ ha wɔ akomam biara so.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I find it interesting how many cultural differences there are between countries.
dialogue.translation: Mɛma no wɔ hɔ deɛ mɛbɛha so, ɛyɛ dɛn a ɛyɛ ntɛm a ɛwɔ nkyea a ɛwɔ mmusua pii so.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, even something like greeting can be a custom that changes the behavior of people.
dialogue.translation: Yiw, sɛe, nnwim bi a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛde nnyɛseɛ a wɔwɔ no ho ase wɔ nnipa so.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For example, in my culture, it's rude to eat with your hands, but in some places it's completely polite.
dialogue.translation: Saa ara na, wɔ nkyea a mɛwɔ ho ase, ɛyɛ akɔteɛ sɛ wo bɛdi dwuma wɔ wo nsa ho, nanso wɔ mmusua pii so, ɛyɛ adwuma pɛ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I usually expect people to follow local customs, but I try to respect different ones.
dialogue.translation: Pɛpɛɛpɛ, mɛhwɛ sɛ nnipa bɛkɔ nnwim a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛde ase, nanso mɛtɔ so mɛbɛtɔ nnwim a ɛntɛm.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's good. I think many customs are similar in essence, just expressed differently.
dialogue.translation: ɛyɛ paa. Mɛbɛha so, nnwim pii wɔ ntɛm wɔ ho nhia, nanso wɔhyɛɛ no ntɛm.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, the key is to be open and learn about the differences between us.
dialogue.translation: Enti, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ pɛe ne yɛnnyɛ ntɛm a ɛwɔ yɛn ntɛm.

key_phrases.translation: kɔ nnwim a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛde ase

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to connect my new phone to the Wi-Fi, but I can't find the settings.
dialogue.translation: Mepɛ sɛ mɛkɔkɔntɛk me phone foforo akyi Wi-Fi no, nanso mɛnhu settings no.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's simple. Just go to the settings app and look for the Wi-Fi option.
dialogue.translation: ɛyɛ simple. Sɛe settings app no mu na hwɛ Wi-Fi option no.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. But I also want to download a new messenger app to message my friends.
dialogue.translation: Oh, mensua. Nanso mepɛ sɛ mɛdownload messenger app foforo bi ma mɛde message ma me nnamfoa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's useful, but check the battery first. Downloading can use a lot of energy.
dialogue.translation: ɛyɛ paa, nanso check battery no mma. Downloading nea ɛsɛe energy pii.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. And what about the screen? Sometimes it stays on too long.
dialogue.translation: Woyɛ nokware. Na screen no nso? Mmom sɛe ɛreyɛ paa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can change that in the settings, too. Also, as a user, you should share your location with friends only if you trust them.
dialogue.translation: Wohwɛ sɛ wode settings no mu nso. Enti, as a user, sɛ wotumi bu wo nnamfoa no, na wode share wo location.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks! Now I feel more comfortable using my device online.
dialogue.translation: Medaase! Yennyɛ, miyɛ paa sɛ mɛde me device no online.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: In my view, the main issue is the budget for the project.
dialogue.translation: Sɛnea me nkyea ako a wo hu akyi no ka, asɛm a ɛyɛ nkwa a ɛyɛ den ni ahyɛde a wɔde ahyɛ ahwɛ a wɔde akye ade paa no.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see your point, however, I think we should consider the timeline first.
dialogue.translation: Mɛnka wo nkuro no, nanso, mɛsɛe sɛ yɛbɛhu akyi ahyɛde a wɔde ahyɛ ahwɛ a wɔde akye ade paa no mu kwan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is a valid point. Therefore, perhaps we can discuss both together.
dialogue.translation: ɛno yɛ nkuro a ɛyɛ den. Entri, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛbɛto asɛm no mu nnɛ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree with that. In addition, we could ask for more data from the team.
dialogue.translation: Mɛyɛ adwene n'asɛm no. Aefe mu, yɛbɛkae sɛ yɛbɛhwehwɛ ahyɛde a wɔde ahyɛ ahwɛ a wɔde akye ade paa no mu nnɛ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea. According to the latest report, we have some flexibility.
dialogue.translation: Adwene a ɛyɛ den. Sɛnea ahyɛde a wɔde ahyɛ ahwɛ a wɔde akye ade paa no ka no, yɛnnyɛ adwene.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I suggest we prepare a proposal with both options.
dialogue.translation: Enti mɛbɔ adwene sɛ yɛbɛyɛ ahyɛde a wɔde ahyɛ ahwɛ a wɔde akye ade paa no mu nnɛ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to study more for my English course, but I don't have much time.
dialogue.translation: Mepɛ sɛ mɛto ntɛm a mɛkɔ English ntɛm no ho, nanso merɛho aduro.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Why don't you practice with me every evening? We can learn together.
dialogue.translation: Na wodeɛ nti na wonhwehwɛ me kɔsi? Yɛnnyɛ susuo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I have a question: do you think our teacher will help us if we don't understand something?
dialogue.translation: Eyɛ adwene pa, nanso mɛnsɔ: susuhyɛ ntɔtɔwura bɛyɛ yɛn akɔntɔn sɛ yɛnntɔn adwene bi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course, our teacher always answers every question with a clear example.
dialogue.translation: Yiw, ntɔtɔwura no ma akwantufo a wɔto so nyinaa ne adansefo a ɛyɛ pa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope I can remember all the new words we learn.
dialogue.translation: Mepɛ sɛ mɛyɛ adwene mu nyinaa a yɛasusu no.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: If you practice daily, you will see that you remember more easily.
dialogue.translation: Sɛ wosusu paa, wɔhu sɛ woyɛ adwene mu paa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's start today, and I'll be a better student!
dialogue.translation: Woyɛ nokware. Yɛnto ntɛm, na mɛyɛ nkɔtofo a ɔyɛ pa!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have a big problem with the schedule for next week.
dialogue.translation: Yɛn wɔ yɛn akwan kɛse so wɔ ɔkɔm deɛ ɛbɛba mu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I know it's hard, but maybe we can find a solution together.
dialogue.translation: Mɛnsa sɛ ɛyɛ kɔkɔ, nanso ɛsɛ sɛ yɛbɛhua sesa paa yɛn ara.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd like to offer my idea: we could move the meeting to Friday.
dialogue.translation: Mepɛ sɛ mɛma me sɛdea: yɛbɛyɛ yɛn asɛm a ɛbɛba ne Friday.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds easy to do, but will everyone agree on the new time?
dialogue.translation: Ɛte sɛ ɛyɛ paa sɛ yɛbɛyɛ, nanso wɔn nyinaa bɛakontaa so a wɔde bɛyɛ ɔkɔm pɔn?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Let's ask them first, and then we can decide what to do.
dialogue.translation: Ma yɛbɔ wɔn kyɛw, na afei yɛbɛtu sɛdeɛ yɛbɛyɛ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good plan. Let's do that and solve this problem today.
dialogue.translation: Sɛdea pa. Ma yɛyɛ no na yɛtogyɛ akwan yi a ɛwɔ hɔ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I can't decide which option to choose for our trip: the bus or the train.
dialogue.translation: Mennkaeɛ sɛ mɛkyɛ dɛn a mɛde ama yɛn nhyɛmu no: trotro anaa trene.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, the bus is cheaper than the train, but it's slower.
dialogue.translation: Ɛyɛ, trotro no hweɛ kɛse trene no, nanso ɛtɔkwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the train costs more, and we need to arrive quickly.
dialogue.translation: Yiw, nanso trene no tɔ paa, na yɛhwɛ sɛ yɛbɛkɔ so kɔso.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Also, the train is safer, especially at night.
dialogue.translation: Enti, trene no bɔɔ, nea ɛbɛyɛ adɛn na ɛyɛ asi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But the train is more expensive, and we can bring more luggage on the bus.
dialogue.translation: Nanso trene no paa, na yɛbɛkɔ akyi akyi apem ntɛmtro trotro no so.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true. So maybe we should take the bus and spend less money.
dialogue.translation: Ɛyɛ nokware. Enti yɛbɛka sɛ yɛde trotro no na yɛatɔ ntɛm.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's go with the bus. We can save money and still have fun.
dialogue.translation: Iye, yɛde trotro no kɔ. Yɛbɛtɔeɛ sika na yɛnnyaeɛ.

vocabulary.note: Hɛn a wɔ’tɔn asɛm bi ara.
Kyerɛ asɛm anaa nnwuma bi a ɛyɛ anigyeee.
Wɔ presentation mu, 'main point' ne adwene a ɛyɛ anigyeee.
Hɛn a wo bɛkɔ asɛm bi a ɛdi kan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's start. My presentation will include three main parts.
dialogue.translation: Okay, ma yɛntɔ. Presentation a mɛbɛma no bɛkɔ asɛm toom ntɛm.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds good. What is your first point?
dialogue.translation: Ɛte sɛ ɛyɛ paa. Adwene bɛn na ɛbɛdi kan?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The first part is about our sales results from last month.
dialogue.translation: Apa a ɛbɛdi kan no ka ho asɛm nhyehyɛe a yɛanya wɔ akɛseɛ no mu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And what will you cover next?
dialogue.translation: Na asɛm bɛn na ɛbɛka aadi?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Next, I'll talk about our main challenges during that period.
dialogue.translation: Aadi, mɛka ho asɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ anigyeee a yɛanya wɔ wɔn mu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Will you also mention the new marketing strategy?
dialogue.translation: Wobɛka nso nnwuma pa a wɔatɔ so no ho asɛm?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's an important point, and I'll end with our goals for this month.
dialogue.translation: Yiw, ɛyɛ nkɔnkɔnsa paa, na mɛtwa wɔ yɛn adwuma a yɛbɛyɛe no ho asɛm.

scenario: Discussing a sport or hobby you follow
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Wɔ wiase yi, ɛma wɔde ka ho asɛm a ɛte sɛ wɔtwa nnipu no anaa nnipu kwan no, na ɛnyɛ wɔ social media so.
Wɔde kasa kɛse a wɔyɛ wɔ nnipua so.
Bere a ɛda: won.
Bere a ɛda: lost.
Ɛso wɔde kasa sɛ ɛyɛ ɔkwan: mmienu a ɛbɔ.
Wɔde ma akwan kyerɛw biara a ɛte sɛ ɛyɛ nokware.
Wɔde kasa nnipua: sɛnea wɔbɛtwa nnipu bi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow any sport? I'm really into football.
dialogue.translation: Wode twa nnipu biara? Mɛtwa nnipu a wɔfrɛ no soccer pii.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I watch basketball. My favorite team is the Lakers, although they don't win every match.
dialogue.translation: Yiw, mɛhu basketball. Nnipu a mɛpɛ so pii no ne Lakers, wɔ haw a wɔntɔ so daa papa biara.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: They played against the Celtics last night, right? Who scored the most points?
dialogue.translation: Wɔtwaa kɔ so Celtics anɔpa, nni hɔ? Na ɔyɛ wɔn a wɔbɔɔ mmienu pii?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yeah, but we lost. Their best player had an amazing game.
dialogue.translation: Yiw, nanso yɛawu. Nnipuo a ɔwɔ hɔ pii no twaa papa a ɛyɛ pɛ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a shame. Do you think they have a chance in the playoffs this season?
dialogue.translation: Ɛyɛ dabi. Wode hu sɛ wɔwɔ akwan wɔ playoffs a ɛbɛba na wɔwɔ kɛseɛ a ɛba no?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe, but it's hard. Although they have good players, they need to improve their defense.
dialogue.translation: Ebia, nanso ɛyɛ anantwie. Wɔ haw a wɔwɔ nnipu a wɔyɛ pɛ, wɔsɛe gyinabea a wɔde kyerɛ aseɛ.
